description: After every query binds the dsqgen values (t05a-h), some cells will still diverge for reasons other than parameters: implementation logic, shared helpers (helper_query_specs.yaml, query_specs.yaml, rollup_helper.py, channel_helper.py, channel_mappings.yaml), multi-channel unions, ROLLUP grouping sets, windows, NULL and decimal semantics. Using the t14 report at the gate scale (about SF 0.1, per t20), fix each at its cause, preferring the shared helper over per-query copies, or classify it with evidence. No item owned this work before: t20 requires zero unclassified divergences but nothing fixed them.
